svg.text: esp32s3_wroom_can_sd_ble_sync_server · SD slot on board · optional RTC (DS3231 / PCF8563)
N16R8 · OPI PSRAM · AMS1117 on board
Serial / "USB awake" via native USB port
TX → TX, RX → RX (not crossed like UART)
All GND are common (car GND = board GND).
Same-name flags (5V, 3V3p, GND) are connected; 3V3p = board 3V3 pin.
TJA1051T/3: VCC = 5V, VIO = 3V3p, S = VIO in the car (hardware silent).
GPIO14: LOW = ignition on (internal pull-up, RTC pull-up in sleep).
Remove the power LED on the board / modules to cut sleep current.
